title: AC1024 LTYPE and AC1015 zero-child FIELD peer-shape fast controls
scope: Add a valid generated AC1024 LTYPE text record beside the existing malformed missing-74 negative
Add generated AC1015 zero-child FIELD controls with a primary value and following-object sentinel
Reuse existing test owners, selectors, and CTest registration

details: Parameterized generated LTYPE header version, defaulting to AC1027; tested AC1024/AC1027 text-bearing records in ASCII and Binary DXF with exact text and following-row assertions.
Strengthened FIELD raw/typed callback pairing and zero-child checks; added AC1015 ASCII/Binary generated cases with primary typed value and a following sentinel object.
Added std::string TestContext::expect overload because the touched assertion labels use dynamically composed strings; preserved the const-char overload by forwarding.

limitations: Tests are generated local structural controls, not a reproduction of peer binaries and not independent format or native-application acceptance. Worktree contains broad unrelated changes; slice remains uncommitted to avoid capturing unrelated edits.
